SRE agent rolled back all production regions from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 unhealthy in all production regions; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's what I did:

1. **Investigated**: Confirmed `checkout-api` was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) on `v2.3.1` with an ~18% error rate, and that the most recent healthy production release was `v2.3.0`.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled all production regions back to `v2.3.0`. The rollout completed and was verified — all three regions now run `v2.3.0`.
3. **Opened incident**: Created **INC-0001** (SEV2, paged on-call) documenting that v2.3.1 failed health checks across all regions, that a rollback to v2.3.0 was executed and verified, and recommending that v2.3.1 not be redeployed until root cause is found.
